home.cinematicTitle: Find the car that fits you.
home.cinematicSubtitle: Choose a car for what matters to you: daily routes, new trips, and the freedom to move.
home.heroSub: Every car is inspected by a mechanic — with a full service history and an honest price.
home.trust1Body: Every car is inspected by a mechanic and comes with a full service history.
home.trust2Body: No hidden accidents, clear customs status, documents in hand.
home.trust3Body: By appointment, at a time that suits you.

buyout.title: We buy your car
buyout.body: We buy your car quickly and pay in cash — same-day valuation, without weeks of waiting for a buyer.

tradein.title: Trade-in
tradein.body: We take your car toward a new one, with a fair amount to pay. We'll match an option to your budget.

credit.title: Credit and installments
credit.body: We'll help you buy on credit or in installments — terms from partner banks.

promo.title: Listing and promotion
promo.body: We'll put your car on the showroom, Instagram, and Telegram — professional photos and a market price.

home.ctaTitle: We’ll match a car and show it in the showroom.
home.aboutP1: We don't collect thousands of random ads. We choose each car, inspect it, and photograph it ourselves.
home.aboutP2: The floor only holds cars we would recommend: a clear history, the real mileage, and the papers in hand.
home.aboutP3: A viewing is by appointment. Come for a test drive, compare a few cars, and decide without being rushed.
home.aboutP4: Selling yours? We'll buy it or take it on commission: photos, calls, and viewings are on us.

documents.q: Which papers come with the car?
documents.a: The sale contract, the service history we have, and the customs papers if the car was imported. You see the folder before you sign.

credit.a: Yes. You can sketch the deposit and the term on the site, and we pass the request to partner banks. The bank decides.

tradein.q: Do you take a car in exchange?
tradein.a: Yes. We value yours and put that amount toward the next one. The difference is agreed before the contract.

testdrive.q: How do I book a test drive?
testdrive.a: Leave a request or call. We agree a time, prepare the car, and meet you at the showroom.

warranty.a: On a used car the terms depend on that car and are written in the contract. A mechanic inspects it before the sale.

delivery.q: Will you deliver to another city?
delivery.a: Yes, within Ukraine. The cost and the time depend on the route, and we name both before you pay.

inspection.q: Who inspects a car before it is sold?
inspection.a: The showroom mechanic. We look at the suspension, engine, body, and electrics. Anything we find is written in the listing.
